verdict.rationale: Productboard's feedback repository explicitly links customer/company attribution to feedback items and features (docs-4, docs-17), centralizes all requests in one searchable place (docs-15), auto-surfaces insights tied to features (docs-16), and is positioned to let PMs share customer context to prioritize what matters (docs-14). This directly matches the story of viewing customer context alongside feedback for prioritization. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the prioritization workflow and UI screenshots showing customer context displayed inline with feedback in practice.
